people.name: Akhil Gupta
people.evidence_quote: considered and unanimously approved the appointment of Mr. Akhil Gupta (DIN: 00028728) as an Additional Director (Non -Executive, Independent) effective November 03, 2026 and as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years with effect from November 03, 2026 to November 02, 2031, subject to the approval of Members of the Company.
people.tenure_quote: and as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years with effect from November 03, 2026 to November 02, 2031, subject to the approval of Members of the Company.
people.bio_quote: Mr. Akhil Gupta is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over four decades of professional experience and has completed the Advanced Management Program from the Harvard Business School at Harvard University, Boston, Massachusetts.
